contractDescription: Defines the API endpoints and their associated data transfer objects (DTOs), which are specified in src/types.ts.

endpoints.description: Fetches the public details of a user based on their username. This is the primary endpoint for the user search feature. The response is either the user data on success or a structured error on failure.

200.description: Successful response containing the user's details.

404.description: The requested user could not be found.
